kpis.description_fr: Potash = potasse fertilisant. Cyclique commodity. Pic 2022 (Russie/Belarus sanctions) puis normalisation 2024.
kpis.description_en: Potash = potash fertilizer. Commodity cyclical. 2022 peak (Russia/Belarus sanctions) then 2024 normalization.

kpis.description_fr: Phosphates = ~50 % du CA Mosaic. Cycle commodity similaire potasse. Plus gros producteur phosphates monde.
kpis.description_en: Phosphates = ~50% of Mosaic revenue. Commodity cycle similar to potash. World's largest phosphate producer.

kpis.description_fr: Brésil = ~35 % du CA. Acquisition Vale 2018. Marché agriculture Brésil structurellement croissant. Volume forte.
kpis.description_en: Brazil = ~35% of revenue. Vale acquisition 2018. Structurally growing Brazilian agriculture market. Strong volume.

kpis.description_fr: Volume total vendu ~16 Mt /an. Stable malgré volatilité prix. Demande structurelle population mondiale.
kpis.description_en: Total volume sold ~16Mt/year. Stable despite price volatility. Structural demand from world population.

kpis.description_fr: EBITDA margin proxy cycle fertilisants. Pic 30 % 2021/22, déclin vers ~18 % en 2024. Cycle bottoming.
kpis.description_en: EBITDA margin = fertilizer cycle proxy. 30% peak 2021/22, decline toward ~18% in 2024. Cycle bottoming.
